entry_state: Product compatibility, supplier capacity, quality, cancellation terms and continuing content rights can distinguish histories with the same balances. The connected result can complete a selected-token query while leaving whole-company reconstruction partial. Its conditional liability histories have identical selected annual rows at alpha1 but different paired future cash classifications and timing. Section2.24.2 has begun separating named-source content from dated investor/system views and a literal-versus-corrected JPMorgan page reference; its correction consequences continue next.

findings.judgment: The connected-example close keeps the JPMorgan navigation proposal separate from Apple's financial history. A wrong-page bounded search needs reconsideration without invalidating independently sourced amounts or proving whole-filing absence.

Chapter3 turns the earlier examples into immutable assertions with context, amount, meaning, clocks and review fields. Its table continues with repeated headers. Measurement mappings, multiple clocks and changing group boundaries each preserve different financial information.

Package freezing, page/heading reconciliation, visited hash/locator traversal and unresolved-target outcomes specify how to account for disclosures before translation. Numerical confidence, correct extraction and reviewed narrative meaning remain separate.

Domestic180+overseas80 and wholesale200+retail60 classify the same260; summing all four gives the invalid520. A visual concern about the partition sentence was checked against extracted text and TeX: it correctly requires disjoint and exhaustive members. No typo is registered.

chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.entry_belief: The product decision promises useful conditional company answers while reported totals conceal history.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.open_question: What must a company representation remember to connect disclosed statements to future journals without inventing facts?
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.parent_contribution: Supplies the synthetic complete-company path, real filing constraints, joint alternatives and sector composition that motivate the later representation and method chapters.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.belief_update: Northstar's common journals connect statements and revisions; Apple exposes measurement, commitment, ownership, legal and operating unknowns. The final paired settlement example answers a narrower question while retaining whole-company and information-view obligations.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.exit_question: Which assertion, context, time, mapping and dependency records preserve those distinctions?
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.removal_verdict: The later abstractions need these concrete financial counterexamples and the connected conditional answer.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.swap_verdict: Worked cases appropriately precede the representation chapter; the closing partial answer brings the long real-company sequence back to the product question.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.entry_verdict: Opening balances establish the synthetic firm; R07-D001 still requires closing inputs before section2.2's movement equations.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.exit_verdict: The final source-view example explains why separate review evidence can accompany a financial result without joining issuers.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.promise_verdict: Complete synthetic construction and partial real-company reconstruction remain distinct. The chapter delivers examples, not an exhaustive Apple ledger or accepted accounting engine.
chapters/13-reference-company.tex:chapte.distinct_contribution_verdict: Joint histories, financial classification and dated source availability become observable implementation requirements; D001/D002/D003 remain repair obligations.

sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.entry_belief: The Apple source facts and uncertainties have been examined separately.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.open_question: Can one answer combine known statement tokens, conditional cash requirements and unresolved history without overstating completion?
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.parent_contribution: Synthesizes the real filing discussion into a query-dependent partial result.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.belief_update: Selected statements, note obligations and conditional journal paths can coexist with an unresolved feasible family and missing clocks. A separate issuer's navigation repair changes only its dependent evidence.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.exit_question: How are these different assertion and result kinds represented?
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.removal_verdict: The synthesis prevents the preceding source examples from remaining an unconnected catalogue.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.swap_verdict: It needs the earlier inventory, asset histories, source updates and review examples to assemble a substantive result.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.entry_verdict: The opening asks what can be said now about the company and cash requirements despite incomplete history.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.exit_verdict: The pointer to AppendixA.3 locates exchange/rejection detail after the financial argument rather than interrupting it.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.promise_verdict: Package counts and completed token reads are not promoted to complete meaning, a history measure or a full feasible remainder.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sec.distinct_contribution_verdict: An unresolved broad task need not erase a narrower supported financial answer.

sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.entry_belief: The conditional result is useful only if its sources and permitted dates are known.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.open_question: What changes between named-source, investor-information and system-as-of queries?
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.parent_contribution: Binds financial and correction results to their particular evidence views.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.belief_update: Later comparatives can be returned by a later named-source query but require exact-byte availability for historical use. A navigation proposal preserves the original literal and invalidates dependent searches without automatically invalidating independent amounts.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.exit_question: What records make view selection and dependency invalidation enforceable?
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.removal_verdict: Otherwise a later expense row or corrected reference could silently enter an earlier query.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.swap_verdict: It follows the joint cash answer because the remaining question is what information that answer is entitled to use.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.entry_verdict: The already examined Americas comparative makes the abstract view difference concrete.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.exit_verdict: Issuer separation and the absence of observed human approval close the correction example precisely.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.promise_verdict: Neither a filing event nor a page-offset change supplies byte-level availability or reconciles the wrong target.
sections/real-package-connection.tex:sub.distinct_contribution_verdict: A proposed repair can alter dependent reasoning while leaving the literal source and independent evidence usable.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.entry_belief: The cases require more than labels and amounts, including unresolved narratives.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.open_question: What is preserved before the modeller accepts an interpretation?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.parent_contribution: Defines an immutable source assertion and the separate derived records that can use it.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.belief_update: Identity, financial context, units, timing, modality and review remain explicit. An analyst threshold for substantially all and an extraction confidence are not source facts or history probabilities.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.exit_question: When do two differently named observations actually measure the same quantity?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.removal_verdict: Every later transformation depends on distinguishing source assertions from derived values.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.swap_verdict: The record must be defined before mappings or view selection operate on it.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.entry_verdict: Northstar, deferred revenue and purchase commitments recall the concrete need for the field table.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.exit_verdict: The qualitative-quantifier example exposes a specific interpretation that cannot be inferred from storage alone.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.promise_verdict: Document, semantic and simulation coverage retain separate denominators and stronger meanings.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:1.distinct_contribution_verdict: An immutable literal survives even when its proposed mapping or numerical interpretation changes.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.entry_belief: Observation records retain labels, context and proposed mappings.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.open_question: Does matching the word debt or revenue establish comparable measurement?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.parent_contribution: Separates economic concepts, presentation relationships and actual basis transformations.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.belief_update: Principal, amortised amount, contractual cash and fair value can coexist; a company extension can remain a broader or unresolved component rather than an equivalent standard concept.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.exit_question: How do dates and revisions affect which assertions may be used together?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.removal_verdict: A vocabulary lookup could otherwise become an unsupported standards conversion.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.swap_verdict: The field definitions supply contexts; clocks next determine which contextual assertions are eligible.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.entry_verdict: Four debt measurements make the label-versus-meaning problem immediate.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.exit_verdict: Tax losses, deferred tax and capital deductions show why the distinction extends beyond financial-statement names.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.promise_verdict: Original bases are retained and comparison books require explicit transformations.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:2.distinct_contribution_verdict: Two correct contemporaneous numbers can answer different measurement questions.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.entry_belief: A retained assertion can refer to an earlier economic event than its report or ingestion date.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.open_question: Which clock and version does an original or as-known query select?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.parent_contribution: Defines economic validity, reporting, public availability and database-time distinctions.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.belief_update: November service, December accounts, March publication and April ingestion answer different questions. Half-open calendar intervals, revision vintage and correlated rounding constrain year-to-date subtraction.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.exit_question: What if the reporting company's perimeter itself changes between dates?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.removal_verdict: Database transaction time alone would leak later revisions into investor histories.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.swap_verdict: Time eligibility follows concept compatibility and precedes the dated company-boundary discussion.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.entry_verdict: The machine example gives each clock a concrete event before introducing temporal storage terminology.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.exit_verdict: Policy, estimate and error changes require their applicable temporal rules instead of one generic revision flag.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.promise_verdict: Named views leave source facts untouched and retain conflicts lacking clear supersession.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:3.distinct_contribution_verdict: Economic-period identity does not make information contemporaneously available.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.entry_belief: Dated balances can change because group membership or measurement changes, not only operations.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.open_question: What makes an increase in group property capital expenditure versus an acquisition or translation movement?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.parent_contribution: Requires dated ownership, control, counterparty and elimination information.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.belief_update: Control needs evidence; group books include separate adjustments. Unmatched eliminations remain unresolved rather than generating a balancing transaction.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.exit_question: Which other features prevent aggregate balances from being sufficient economic state?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.removal_verdict: Without this distinction a scenario could extrapolate an acquisition-driven asset increase as recurring investment.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.swap_verdict: Its dated relationships rely on the clock discussion and prepare the wider representation difficulties.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.entry_verdict: Legal entity, reported group and exposure are separated before the acquisition example.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.exit_verdict: A constant-perimeter analysis is explicitly a derived assumption rather than a rewritten report.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.promise_verdict: A majority stake or a balancing plug is not promoted into a consolidation conclusion or recovered transaction.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:4.distinct_contribution_verdict: Reported group movements can differ from the underlying entities' operating movements.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.entry_belief: Contexts, clocks and perimeter already constrain interpretation.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.open_question: What other economic distinctions can disappear in aggregate reported balances?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.parent_contribution: Collects the remaining recognition, currency, vintage, extraction and behavioural requirements before operational procedures.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.belief_update: Net debt can conceal gross turnover; equal carrying amounts can hide maturity; lots and functional currencies matter; calibrated or assumed behaviour is needed beyond identities.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.exit_question: How does the importer first establish what disclosure material it must account for?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.removal_verdict: The later representation procedures need these explicit examples of state lost by aggregation.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.swap_verdict: It bridges the conceptual distinctions to package, narrative and mapping procedures.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.entry_verdict: Sale, invoice, collection and impairment on four dates connect the list to ordinary accounting.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.exit_verdict: Bank asset shrinkage and insurer choices explain why strategy cannot be deduced from a balance identity.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.promise_verdict: Dash meanings and extraction confidence remain unresolved categories rather than forced numerical answers.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:5.distinct_contribution_verdict: Operational response and off-balance exposures require information beyond recognized balances.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.entry_belief: Extracted assertions alone cannot prove that a filing or its meaning was fully covered.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.open_question: How are missing pages, incorporated targets and unsupported narrative predicates kept visible?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.parent_contribution: Supplies a bounded inventory/reconciliation and reference-traversal procedure before semantic translation.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.belief_update: Content headings are checked against detected units; hash/locator visits bound cycles. Missing and ambiguous targets remain obligations. Numerical and narrative acceptance are separate decisions.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.exit_question: What evidence permits mappings and aggregations after those assertions are retained?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.removal_verdict: The earlier coverage requirement otherwise lacks a concrete importer procedure.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.swap_verdict: The importer must account for source units before mapping their interpreted financial meaning.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.entry_verdict: Freezing bytes, dates, availability evidence and references establishes the procedure's starting input.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.exit_verdict: Fixed-rate notes, repurchase permission and conditional guarantees show why a correct literal does not settle its constraint translation.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.promise_verdict: Resource-limited traversal and acquired-file closure are not called complete incorporated-disclosure closure.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:6.distinct_contribution_verdict: Semantic coverage may be only a lower-bound assertion inventory even after every acquired page has a disposition.

chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.entry_belief: Source labels need explicit financial relationships before substitution or aggregation.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.open_question: When can a mapping compose or an axis be summed without double counting?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.parent_contribution: Defines contextual mapping relationships and partition evidence with valid/invalid examples.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.belief_update: Component then equivalence remains component; transforms need compatible intermediate bases. Product-region and channel classifications cannot be pooled, and an unallocated residual is not zero.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.exit_question: Which eligible assertion version does a query actually select?
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.removal_verdict: The shared260 revenue classified on two axes is the concrete double-counting failure case.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.swap_verdict: It uses retained source/context evidence before chronological selection is formalized.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.entry_verdict: Mapping source, target, relationship, context and transformation are stated before the composition rules.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.exit_verdict: Vendor non-trade receivables and gross derivatives anchor the prohibition on silent relabeling/netting.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.promise_verdict: Company extensions preserve distinctions but cannot override mandatory recognition rules.
chapters/02-history.tex:section:7.distinct_contribution_verdict: A financial relationship, rather than similar naming, licenses every allowed composition or sum.

exit_state: Chapter2 closes with a supported partial answer and a separately scoped navigation proposal. Chapter3 now defines immutable assertions, explicit measurement mappings, four clocks, changing perimeter and package/narrative coverage. Axis totals need disjoint exhaustive membership and cannot be added across classifications. Section3.8 has begun eligibility filtering and acyclic supersession; original/latest/harmonised selection and its worked consequences continue next.
